risks: model ranking does not hold across windows
only 3 validation windows: weight estimation is high variance
diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong downward trend (a net fall of ~211% of its level). A moderate seasonal pattern is present. The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.068), which favours a robust combination.

Series context: trend strength 0.9584 and seasonal strength 0.3211; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.068); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.552.
